name: comp-587

frames.best_why: All three icon links are visible and Home shows its active outline.

tagline: Slim app bar pairing three icon links with a search field.
summary: A dark header with a starburst logo, three rounded links that pair an icon with a word (Home, Inbox, Insights), and a search box with a magnifier at the right.
appearance: A slim dark header with a starburst logo on the left, three pill links for Home, Inbox and Insights each with a small icon, and a rounded search field with a magnifier at the right. The current link sits inside a faint rounded outline.
behaviour: Moving the pointer over a nav pill gives it a faint rounded outline, while Home keeps a persistent active outline. Typing in the search field fills it with a query and adds a native clear button.
demo_content: Links read Home, Inbox and Insights; the search placeholder is Search... and the typed example is a short query.
search_phrases: header with search and icon links
use_when: A web app needs a slim header combining a few icon links with search.
avoid_when: Only three fixed areas are wired; search has no results logic and the links are placeholders.
customise: The three nav labels, their icons, the active item and the search placeholder are set in the file; no props change them.
weight_why: A logo, three small links and one input.

a11y.note: Nav links carry visible text, but the logo link is unnamed and the search field has no label.

issues: Catalogue claims an app switcher, notifications, user menu and upgrade button; none are here.
polish_why: Clean, evenly spaced header; active and hover outlines look almost identical.
title: App Icon Nav Header
